# CUSAT Boxing Club — Official Information & Guide

> CUSAT Boxing Club is the premier boxing & combat sports academy located at the CUSAT Sports Complex in South Kalamassery, Kochi, Kerala. It is officially affiliated with Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) and the Kerala Boxing Association.

## Summary & Key Info
- **Entity Name**: CUSAT Boxing Club (also known as CUSAT Boxing Gym, CUSAT Combat Sports)
- **Location**: CUSAT Sports Complex, South Kalamassery, Kochi, Kerala 682022, India
- **Open To**: 100% Open to the General Public — School Children, Youth Cadets, University Students, Working Professionals, Men & Women across Kochi and Kerala.
- **Affiliation**: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) & Kerala Boxing Association

## Training Schedule & Batch Timings
- **Morning Batch**: 6:00 AM – 8:30 AM (Monday through Saturday)
- **Evening Batch**: 4:30 PM – 7:30 PM (Monday through Saturday)

## Programs & Divisions
1. **School Boxing Cadets**: Tailored amateur boxing training for school children (ages 8+), building discipline, agility, self-defense, and physical fitness.
2. **Youth & Junior Boxing**: Competitive sparring, footwork, speed bag work, and tactical drills for state & national level boxing championships.
3. **University Varsity Squad**: High-performance varsity training for CUSAT inter-university boxing athletes and medal contenders.
4. **Adult & Professional Evening Gym**: Cardio conditioning, heavy bag training, mitt work, and boxing fitness for working professionals and adult beginners.

## Facilities & Equipment
- Full 20ft x 20ft competition ring with shock-absorbent padding
- Heavy leather punching bags, double-end reflex bags, speed bags
- Plyometric & strength conditioning zone
- Video analysis & tactical briefing area

## How to Join & Book Free Trial
Prospective boxers and beginners can register for a free trial session online at https://cusatboxingclub.vercel.app/trial or by contacting +91 95444 57903.
